text_blocks.snippet: Yes, there are tests to detect past SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) infection. Specifically, antibody tests (also known as serology tests) can be used to identify individuals who have been infected with the virus. These tests detect the presence of antibodies, which are proteins produced by the immune system in response to the virus. Antibody tests are not used to diagnose an active infection, but rather to indicate past exposure to the virus.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, there are tests to detect past SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) infection

text_blocks.snippet: Here's why these tests are useful:

list.title: Identify past infections:
list.snippet: Antibody tests can show if someone has been exposed to COVID-19, even if they didn't have symptoms or didn't get tested during the acute illness.

list.title: Provide information about immunity:
list.snippet: While not a perfect indicator of immunity, the presence of antibodies can suggest that the individual's immune system has some experience with the virus and may offer some protection against future infection.
